cli_cmd_branch-fw:
configure terminal
branch-fw(config)#  configure terminal
branch-fw(config)# object network OBJ_INSIDE_10_0_1_0
branch-fw(config-network-object)# subnet 10.0.1.0 255.255.255.0
branch-fw(config-network-object)# exit
branch-fw(config)# object network OBJ_REMOTE_10_1_0_0_30
branch-fw(config-network-object)# subnet 10.1.0.0 255.255.255.252
branch-fw(config-network-object)# exit
branch-fw(config)# access-list ALLOW_INTERSUBNET extended permit icmp object OBJ_REMOTE_10_1_0_0_30 object OBJ_INSIDE_10_0_1_0 echo
branch-fw(config)# access-list ALLOW_INTERSUBNET extended permit icmp object OBJ_REMOTE_10_1_0_0_30 object OBJ_INSIDE_10_0_1_0 echo-reply
branch-fw(config)# access-list ALLOW_INTERSUBNET extended permit icmp any object OBJ_INSIDE_10_0_1_0 time-exceeded
branch-fw(config)# access-list ALLOW_INTERSUBNET extended permit icmp any object OBJ_INSIDE_10_0_1_0 unreachable
branch-fw(config)# no access-group ALLOW_INTERSUBNET in interface inside
branch-fw(config)# logging enable
branch-fw(config)# logging buffered warnings
branch-fw(config)# access-list ALLOW_INTERSUBNET extended deny ip any any log interval 300
branch-fw(config)# end
branch-fw#
